{{Short description|Bound in mathematics}}
In [[mathematics]], the '''Mestre bound''' is a bound on the [[Rank of an abelian group|analytic rank]] of an [[elliptic curve]] in terms of [[Conductor of an elliptic curve|its conductor]], introduced by {{harvs|txt|last=Mestre|year=1986}}.
